description: This file defines the static class DefaultClientServices within the Orleans namespace, responsible for registering default services for an Orleans client. It contains methods for adding and configuring core services, networking, type metadata, and provider subsections, as well as internal classes for configuration purposes.

classes.name: DefaultClientServices
classes.description: Static class responsible for configuring default services for an Orleans client, including adding core services, networking, serialization, and provider configurations.

methods.name: AddDefaultServices
methods.description: Adds and configures the default services for an Orleans client builder, including networking, serialization, type providers, and more.

methods.name: ApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Runs configuration routines to set various options and subsections for the Orleans client based on provided configuration sections.

inner_classes.name: RootConfiguration
inner_classes.description: Internal class for encapsulating configuration sections related to clustering.

inner_classes.name: AllowOrleansTypes
inner_classes.description: Implements ITypeNameFilter to allow types from assemblies containing 'Orleans' in their name.

inner_classes.name: ServicesAdded
inner_classes.description: Marker class used internally to identify if services have been added.

methods.name: AddDefaultServices
methods.description: Main method for registering core Orleans client services and dependencies into the dependency injection container.

methods.name: ApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Configures various options and subsections for the Orleans client based on the 'Orleans' configuration section.
